government_structure: Unitary, decentralised state. National social-security funds (Caf/Cnaf for family and housing benefits and RSA payment, Cpam/Cnam for health insurance, Carsat/Cnav for basic pensions, Urssaf for contributions, MSA for the agricultural regime) and national administrations (DGFiP for tax, DGDDI for customs, France Travail for employment and unemployment benefits, INPI guichet unique for business registration, prefectures/DGEF for residence permits and naturalisation, ANTS/France Titres with prefecture CERTs for identity documents, driving licences and vehicle registration) deliver the main services. Départements own the RSA decision, insertion and disability (MDPH) and elderly-care (APA) services; communes hold civil registration (état civil) and receive identity-document applications; the MEAE service central d'état civil handles civil status of French nationals abroad.

legal_information.name: Légifrance
legal_information.publisher: DILA (Direction de l'information légale et administrative, Premier ministre)
legal_information.note: Consolidated codes, laws, decrees and arrêtés with ChronoLégi point-in-time versions (CRPA shown 'En vigueur au 31/10/2026', data last updated 28 May 2026). API Légifrance (JSON) on PISTE after free registration, Licence Ouverte 2.0, per-token quotas; stable version since 4 April 2023. Fonds also cover JORF, circulaires et instructions (10,644 texts, filters by ministry/date/NOR/opposability), CNIL, administrative and judicial case law (CETAT: 573,087 decisions).
legal_information.consolidation_lag: Consolidation is continuous; CRPA page showed data update of 28 May 2026 against a view date of 31 Oct 2026; LEGI XML dump on data.gouv.fr updated 29 Oct 2026.

legal_information.name: LEGI, JORF, KALI, CIRCULAIRES open-data dumps (echanges.dila.gouv.fr)
legal_information.note: LEGI: 73 codes in force + 29 repealed, exhaustive for laws, ordinances and decrees since 1945, every article version kept; XML with DILA DTDs, HTTPS and FTPS bulk download, Licence Ouverte. Most ministerial circulars are not in LEGI (separate CIRCULAIRES fonds).
legal_information.consolidation_lag: XML updated 'avant-hier' relative to 30 Oct 2026 view

internal_guidance_practice: Strong, by French standards unusual, practice of publishing regulatory instructions to the network, but not procedure manuals or case-system descriptions. Cnaf publishes its 'instructions au réseau' (types C = circulaire, LR = lettre réseau, IT = instruction technique) on caf.fr by year; the template opened (LR 2025-172) carries addressees (directeurs de Caf), issuing department, 'Processus de rattachement: M5 ...' (a reference to the branch's internal process map), 'Diffusion réseau / Diffusion caf.fr / Communicable loi CADA', texts abrogated and actions with deadlines. Cnav publishes numbered circulaires (e.g. 2025-10 of 14 March 2025) addressed to the directors of Carsat/CGSS with scope tables and numbered points on legislation.lassuranceretraite.fr. France Travail publishes a Bulletin officiel (bo.francetravail.org) with instructions DG, décisions, délibérations and notes d'information, searchable by theme/category/date with repealed texts; most entries are delegations of signature, but instructions DG (e.g. 2024-7 on mobility aid, updated June 2026) exist. DGFiP's BOFiP is the complete opposable tax doctrine and DGFiP publishes the source code of its tax calculators (M language, C, Java, Cobol) on GitLab Adullact. Unédic publishes the circulaires applying unemployment-insurance rules (2026-06). Ministerial circulars are on Légifrance (10,644 texts) under R312-8 CRPA. Cnaf published in January 2026 the variables and PySpark source code of its data-mining risk-scoring model (DMDE 2026) after litigation before the Conseil d'État. Not found: Cnaf's internal 'suivi législatif' and processing manuals for the Cristal case system, France Travail's operational procedure guides, CNAM lettres-réseau for the current years (circulaires.ameli.fr returned 503 on all attempts; only 1980s-2005 PDFs surfaced in search), Urssaf/Acoss lettres circulaires (urssaf.fr returned 503). caf.fr HTML pages are behind bot protection (Radware) although the PDFs download.

layer_scores.reason: Service-public.gouv.fr fiches hold steps, conditions, deadlines, cerfa forms, online services, legal basis, responsible bodies and channels (RSA F19778 opened), and the whole corpus is a daily XML dump on data.gouv.fr (v3.5); the annuaire has an open JSON API; entreprendre.service-public.gouv.fr covers firms. Coverage is national; subnational services appear only through the annuaire.

Légifrance serves consolidated codes, laws, decrees and arrêtés with point-in-time versions (CRPA opened 'En vigueur au 31/10/2026'), the LEGI/JORF/KALI fonds are bulk XML on echanges.dila.gouv.fr updated near-daily, and the Légifrance API (JSON, PISTE) exposes the same fonds including circulaires and case law.

Detailed per-service guidance for every main agency is centralised on service-public.gouv.fr (DILA), enumerable through the daily XML dump and offered in English as flagged machine translation; agencies add their own doctrine (BOFiP, Unédic circulaires). Agency sites (ameli.fr, caf.fr, urssaf.fr) could not be opened in this session (403/503/bot protection).

Cerfa forms for the main agencies are catalogued as R-records on service-public.gouv.fr (cerfa 15481/15482/14130 for RSA) and included in the XML dump, and most procedures run as online forms on demarche.numerique.gouv.fr (22.8M dossiers); no field specifications or machine-readable form definitions were found.

The main funds publish their instructions to the network systematically and in enumerable repositories: Cnaf instructions au réseau (C/LR/IT) by year on caf.fr with a template that names the internal process ('Processus de rattachement M5') and a CADA-communicability flag; Cnav numbered circulaires with predictable PDF names on legislation.lassuranceretraite.fr; France Travail's searchable Bulletin officiel (instructions DG, notes d'information, repealed texts); DGFiP's BOFiP and tax-calculator source code; Unédic circulaires; 10,644 ministerial circulaires on Légifrance via API; Cnaf's scoring-model code released in 2026. These are regulatory instructions, not procedure manuals or case-system descriptions, and CNAM/Urssaf repositories were unreachable in this pass.

Per-service volumes and some processing-time indicators are published: France Travail statistics hub and data.gouv.fr series, 'taux de premier paiement dans les délais' by agency, Services Publics+ per-site results for Cnaf/Cnam/France Travail/prefectures/DGFiP/Urssaf/Carsat/MSA, DINUM quarterly observatoire dataset, Cnaf/Cnam/Urssaf/DREES open-data portals. No open data on decision outcomes or automation rates at case level was found.

Administrative court decisions (CE, CAA, TA) are searchable on ArianeWeb and Légifrance (573,087 CETAT decisions, API) and downloadable in bulk XML from opendata.justice-administrative.fr; judicial-order decisions via the Judilibre API; CADA opinions searchable and dumped as CSV. The Défenseur des droits database could not be opened (503).

notes: France is tier-4 candidate on paper: law and catalogue are machine-readable and the funds publish their network instructions. Limits for a mapper: (1) the published instructions are regulatory (rates, eligibility interpretation), not operating procedures or case-system behaviour; the Cnaf 'Processus de rattachement' field shows an internal process map exists but it is not published; (2) several agency sites block automated access (caf.fr Radware, ameli.fr 403, urssaf.fr/boss.gouv.fr/cnsa.fr 503, interieur.gouv.fr 403, gitlab.adullact.net Anubis), so the authority pass needs a browser or allow-listing; (3) the Défenseur des droits decision database and CNAM circulaires.ameli.fr were unreachable. Web search budget was exhausted before CNAM, BOSS, Défenseur des droits and Cnav statistics could be searched further; findings on those rest on fetched pages or secondary sources as noted.
